requirements: Many-to-one material lots and one-to-many trials must remain explicit
Every repeated or cross-fixture cycle advances sample state and retains prior load history
Frames retain original bytes/time, masks and corrections; never overwrite raw data
Camera, tester and analysis records join on run_id with versioned time and coordinate mappings
Specimen reuse and replacement are explicit events
Fixture replacement invalidates stale contact calibration
No sample provenance from a schematic asset or literature outcome
